title: Building a 2025 Developer Portfolio with Next.js, Aceternity UI, and Tailwind
transcript:
In 2025, component libraries like Aceternity UI and Shadcn UI have set a new visual standard for portfolios:
Bento grid components, glowing border cards, moving border buttons, and animated background grids.
Key components to include:
1. Spotlight hero: A subtle conical or radial glow that follows the mouse across the dark background.
2. Animated Pin or Hover Card: Cards that elevate and cast soft colored drop shadows on hover.
3. Tech Stack Infinite Marquee: A smooth horizontal ticker showing logos of languages, frameworks, and tools you use.
4. Contact section with a copy-to-clipboard button for your email address with immediate visual checkmark feedback.
